name: sk-design
description: Design parent hub. One advisor identity routing through mode-registry.json and hub-router.json to nested workflow packets: sk-design-fundamentals for the values a surface is built from, and sk-design-md-generator for measuring an existing surface into a Style Reference and validating it. Reinstated after the August 2026 deprecation, with a mode count and a shared subject the two-mode hub did not have.
